notes.title: NO TIME TO LOOT EVENT UPDATE
notes.notes: [p]Hello Strugglers,[/p][p][b]Dustbound[/b] is back with its biggest content drop yet — and we can’t wait for you to dive in! This update brings a brand-new map, tons of fresh content, and an all-new combo system to shake up your runs.[/p][p][/p][h2]What’s New[/h2][list][*][p][b]New Map[/b]: Explore an entirely fresh battlefield packed with unique challenges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Enemies[/b]: Face off against a host of deadly new foes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 New Mini-Bosses[/b] + [b]1 New Boss[/b]: Test your skills against powerful opponents with unique mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]20+ New Cards[/b]: Expand your arsenal with new strategic options.[/p][/*][*][p][b]10 New Augments[/b]: Customize and power up your build even further.[/p][/*][*][p][b]20+ New Combos[/b]: Unlock powerful synergies by playing certain cards or deploying specific drones. These combos grant special buffs, trigger new weapons, and open the door to deeper strategies.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]The New Combo System[/h2][p]The heart of this update is the [b]Combo System[/b]. By mixing and matching the right cards or drones, you can unlock hidden interactions that lead to powerful bonuses, devastating weapons, or unique effects. With over 20 combos to discover, experimentation is more rewarding than ever![/p][p][/p][h2]Jump Back In[/h2][p]Whether you’re here for the new bosses, the expanded deckbuilding options, or just want to break the game wide open with insane combos, this update gives you more ways to struggle, survive, and thrive.[/p][p]So… what are you waiting for? Get back out there, Strugglers. Loot won’t wait.[/p][p]Nordman[/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Dustbound Playtest Incoming! Try It Now! 🚀
notes.notes:
Survivors, the time has come! Dustbound is gearing up for its first public playtest, and we need YOU to help shape the wasteland.

🔥 What to Expect:
✅ First hands-on experience with Dustbound’s core mechanics
✅ Test the unique mix of deckbuilding & bullet heaven
✅ Provide feedback & help improve the game before launch


Your feedback is critical to making Dustbound the best it can be. Join the fight, test your strategies, and help refine the game before it releases into the wild!

Sign up now and prepare for the storm! 🌪️🔥

notes.title: Welcome to the Wastelands! 🏜️
notes.notes:
I’m beyond excited to announce my new game, Dustbound, a unique blend of deckbuilding and bullet-heaven chaos. In this game, you’ll scavenge the remnants of a distant planet whose once-thriving civilization has long since crumbled. Explore mystical ruins, uncover ancient artifacts, and use them to craft your survival strategy.

Build your deck, command customizable drones, and face relentless waves of raiders and monsters. Adapt your playstyle with powerful cards, synergize augments, and harness the dice mechanic to shape your deck into something truly unstoppable.

Prepare for intense battles, fast-paced runs, and endless possibilities. The wastelands are waiting—will you rise to the challenge?

👉 Wishlist on Steam

👉 Try the Prototype on Itch.io: https://nordm4n.itch.io/dustboundprototype

Soon a playtest with more cards, enemies, players, weather events, and better sound will follow!
